input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, damages exclusion or "aggregate liability" language anywhere: searches for "liability", "liable", "damages", "consequential" and "indemnif" return only the No Joint Venture provision (p0061-p0062), and the Warranties section (p0055-p0058) and General Provisions (p0059-p0070) are silent on liability. There is also no indemnity to carve out. Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct and consequential damages, so the rule's expected clause is missing rather than merely a deviation. We insert the preferred mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees (fees here are the 30% of Net Sales payable by the Company under Section 3, p0019, which is a meaningful, non-illusory base) and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, plus confirmation that the Company's payment obligations are outside the cap. Placed at the end of Section 9 so it benefits from the existing survival provision (p0068).

proposal.summary: Insert a mutual limitation of liability with a 12-month fees / USD 1,000,000 cap and uncapped carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited and consequential damages, so we have added our standard mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not limited by it.

ops.text: 9A. Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to pay amounts due under Section 3 shall not be subject to the foregoing limitation.
